declarations.description:
A long list that only renders what you can see. It windows `items` to the visible range plus an overscan margin with
the same `VirtualScrollController` the data grid uses, so 50 000 rows cost the same DOM as 20, and it renders every
visible row as a real `c2-list-item` — the same markup, slots, selection styling and theme as `c2-list`.

```html
<c2-virtual-list
  style="height: 320px"
  searchable
  highlight
  selection="single"
  item-key="id"
  label-field="name"
  description-field="team"
></c2-virtual-list>
<script type="module">
  document.querySelector('c2-virtual-list').items = people
</script>
```

**Give the host a height** (or `--c2-virtual-list--max-height`) — the list scrolls inside it.

**Uniform item height.** Windowing needs every row to be the same height. The height comes from
`--c2-virtual-list__item--height` and is re-measured from the first rendered row, so a theme change is picked up;
`item-height` is only the estimate used for the first paint. A list with two-line rows must raise the variable.

A run of adjacent selected rows squares the corners between them, so it reads as one block rather than a stack of
separate pills — the same `joined-before` / `joined-after` contract `c2-list` uses.

**Search.** `searchable` adds a search field above the list; `search` is also a plain property, so an external input
can drive it instead. Matching runs over `search-fields` (falling back to `label-field` and `description-field`, then
to every string value of the item), and `matcher` replaces that logic outright. `highlight` wraps the matched text in
`<mark>`. With a `dataSource` the query is sent to the server instead and the local matcher is never used.

Set `aria-label` on the host to name the list; it is mirrored onto the inner `role="listbox"`, which falls back to
`Items`.

slots.description: Replaces the built-in search field. Set `search` yourself from its events.
slots.name: search

slots.description: Extra controls beside the search field, for a filter chip or a count. Hidden when empty.
slots.name: toolbar

slots.description: Bar below the list, for a total or a pager. Hidden when empty.
slots.name: footer

slots.description: Replaces the built-in "no matches" message shown while a search is active.
slots.name: no-results

slots.description: Replaces the built-in spinner shown while the first items load.
slots.name: loading

slots.description: Replaces the built-in message shown when `error` is set.
slots.name: error

members.name: items
members.description: The items to display. An array in the property, JSON in the attribute.

members.name: itemKey
members.description: Field used as the identity of an item, for selection and typeahead. Falls back to the item index.

members.name: labelField
members.description: Field read for a row's primary text. Defaults to `label`, `name`, `title` or `value`, then the item itself.

members.name: descriptionField
members.description: Field read for a row's second, muted line.

members.name: disabledField
members.description: Field whose truthy value makes a row unselectable.

members.name: renderItem
members.description: Renders a row's content, replacing the label/description pair.

members.name: matcher
members.description: Replaces the built-in field matching while searching.

members.name: comparator
members.description: Client-side sort comparator for the `sort` field's values.

members.name: dataSource
members.description: Lazy item source used instead of `items`; the list requests one block at a time as rows scroll into view.

members.name: searchable
members.description: Shows the built-in search field above the list.

members.name: search
members.description: The query the list is filtered by. Set by the built-in field, or from outside.

members.name: searchFields
members.description: Fields the query is matched against: an array in the property, `;`-separated in the attribute.

members.name: minSearchLength
members.description: Queries shorter than this are ignored, so the list is not filtered on the first keystroke.

members.name: searchDebounce
members.description: Milliseconds the built-in field waits after the last keystroke before the query is applied.

members.name: searchPlaceholder
members.description: Placeholder of the built-in search field.

members.name: highlight
members.description: Wraps the matched part of a row's text in `<mark part="highlight">`.

members.name: sort
members.description: The sort: `SortEntry` in the property, `field:asc` in the `sort` attribute.

members.name: selection
members.description: `single` selects one row at a time, `multiple` supports ⌘/ctrl-click and shift-click ranges.

members.name: value
members.description: Keys of the selected items: an array in the property, `;`-separated in the attribute.

members.name: virtual
members.description: `auto` windows past `virtual-threshold` items; `always` and `never` force it.

members.name: itemHeight
members.description: Item height in pixels used before the first row has been measured.

members.name: overscan
members.description: Rows rendered above and below the viewport while windowing.

members.name: virtualThreshold
members.description: Item count past which `virtual="auto"` starts windowing.

members.name: blockSize
members.description: Number of items the list asks a `dataSource` for at a time.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows the loading state; implied while a `dataSource` resolves its first block.

members.name: error
members.description: Shows the error state with this message.

members.name: emptyMessage
members.description: Message shown when there are no items at all.

members.name: noResultsMessage
members.description: Message shown when a search is active and nothing matches.

members.name: #visibleItems
members.description: The items on show: `items` after search and sort. Empty while a `dataSource` is in charge.

members.name: #selectedKeysOf
members.description: `value` as a set, rebuilt only when the array identity changes, so a big selection costs one lookup per row.

members.name: #virtualizer
members.default: new VirtualScrollController(this, { scrollElement: () => this.viewport, itemCount: () => this.itemCount, itemHeight: () => this.#itemHeightPx, overscan: () => this.overscan, enabled: () => this.isVirtualized, })

members.name: itemCount
members.description: Number of items on show right now: the filtered `items`, or the `dataSource` total for the current query.

members.name: isVirtualized
members.description: Whether the rows are currently windowed.

members.name: searching
members.description: Whether a query is currently narrowing the list.

members.name: getSelectedItems
members.description: The items currently selected. Only the loaded ones when a `dataSource` is used.

members.name: selectAll
members.description: Selects every loaded item. Only meaningful with `selection="multiple"`.

members.name: scrollToIndex
members.description: Scrolls the item at `index` into view, aligning it to the closest edge.

members.name: focusItem
members.description: Moves the roving focus to `index`, scrolling it into view first.

members.name: refresh
#decorate
members.description: Wraps every occurrence of the query in `<mark>`, so a match is visible without the reader hunting for it.

members.name: #rebuildVisibleItems
members.description: Search, then sort — the order a reader expects: they filter first and only then ask how it is ordered.

members.name: #searchableValues
members.description: The strings a query is tested against: the declared fields, else the labelled ones, else everything scalar.

members.name: #isSelectedAt
members.description: Whether the row at `index` is selected — false for one a `dataSource` has not delivered, which cannot be.

members.name: #labelOf
members.description: A row's primary text: the declared field, the first conventional one, or the item itself for a list of strings.

members.name: #ensureBlocks
members.description: Asks the source for whatever block the visible window needs and has not got.

members.name: #typeIntoSearchField
members.description: Sends a character typed on the list to the search field, so typing anywhere in the component starts a search.

members.name: #typeaheadTo
members.description: The `c2-list` behaviour for a list with no search field: jump to the next row whose label starts with the run.

members.name: #syncFocusToWindow
members.description:
Keeps the roving tab stop inside the rendered window. Scrolling far away would otherwise leave no row with
`tabindex="0"`, and the list would drop out of the tab order entirely.

events.name: search-change
events.description: Fired after the query settles, with the number of items that match.

events.name: item-click
events.description: Fired when a row is clicked, before the selection is applied.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired after the user changes the selection. `detail.value` is the array of selected keys, `detail.items` the matching items.
